# Freeland Animal Hospital

> A comprehensive AAHA-accredited veterinary hospital in Indianapolis providing preventive care, surgical services, dental care, and emergency treatment for dogs and cats.

Freeland Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary clinic located in Indianapolis, Indiana, offering a wide range of pet healthcare services including wellness exams, surgery, dental care, diagnostics, and parasite prevention. The hospital is accredited by the American Animal Hospital Association and features an experienced team of veterinarians and technicians committed to pet health and safety.

## Key Topics

- AAHA Accreditation

## Core Services

- [Veterinary Services](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/veterinary-services): Overview of comprehensive veterinary services including surgery and diagnostics
- [Pet Wellness Care](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/pet-wellness-care): Wellness packages, vaccinations, and preventive care for cats and dogs
- [Animal Dental Services](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/animal-dental-services): Dental cleaning and oral care services for dogs and cats
- [Pet Surgery](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/pet-surgery): Surgical services with pre-operative care and anesthesia safety protocols
- [Animal Diagnostics](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/animal-diagnostics): In-house diagnostic testing and laboratory services with same-day results
- [Digital X-Rays](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/veterinary-services/digital-x-rays): Digital X-ray diagnostic imaging technology for pet health assessment
- [Animal Parasites](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/animal-parasites): Parasite prevention and control including flea, tick, and heartworm protection
- [Senior Pet Care](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/senior-pet-care): Specialized care for aging pets including wellness exams and preventive care
- [Pet Microchipping](https://freelandanimalhospital.com/pet-microchipping): Pet microchipping service using HomeAgain identification system
